command:
set -eu
python -c 'import sqlite3; print("initial SQLite",sqlite3.sqlite_version)'
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gcc libc6-dev
python /work/scripts/build_sqlite_runtime.py --prefix /result/runtime --output /result/build-report.json --archive /work/sqlite.tar.gz
printf '%s\n' /result/runtime/lib > /etc/ld.so.conf.d/00-airlock-sqlite.conf
ldconfig
env -i PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin python /work/airlock/sqlite_runtime.py --pin-file /work/configs/sqlite-runtime.json --output /result/minimal-env-runtime.json
